# Dr. Abdullah Medical Clinic - DI Khan

> Dr. Abdullah is a leading General Physician & Medical Consultant in Dera Ismail Khan (DI Khan), Pakistan, offering comprehensive primary healthcare, online appointment booking, digital prescriptions, and patient records access.

## General Information
- **Doctor Name**: Dr. Abdullah
- **Specialty**: General Physician & Medical Consultant
- **Location**: Eid Gaah Road, Dera Ismail Khan, Pakistan
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 343 0277466
- **Email**: dr.abdullah.dik@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://drabdullah.netlify.app/

## Core Medical Services
- **General Checkups**: Comprehensive physical exams, vital sign monitoring, and routine wellness screening.
- **Medical Consultation**: One-on-one evaluations for acute and chronic symptoms.
- **Diagnosis & Treatment**: Evidence-based management of fever, infections, diabetes, hypertension, asthma, and digestive disorders.
- **Preventive Care**: Immunity boosting, lifestyle counseling, and early disease detection.
- **Patient Portal & Medical Records**: Secure online access to past lab reports, diagnoses, and digital prescriptions.
- **Doctor Portal**: Secure appointment management, prescription writing, and real-time clinic announcements.
